title: Transfer of an a.e. identity on M to almost every slice M ∩ f⁻¹{t} (parent Step 5)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let μ and ν be measures on ℝ^P, let M ⊆ ℝ^P be μ-null-measurable, let S ⊆ ℝ^P be Borel, let f : ℝ^P → ℝ be Borel, and let g, F : ℝ^P → ℝ be arbitrary functions. Assume three things. (NT) For every Z ⊆ M with μ(Z) = 0, ν(Z ∩ f⁻¹{t}) = 0 for Lebesgue-a.e. t. Next, g(x) = 0 for every x ∉ S. Finally, for μ⌞M-a.e. x, x ∈ S implies g(x) = F(x). Then for Lebesgue-a.e. t ∈ ℝ, ∫_{M∩f⁻¹{t}} g dν = ∫_{{x ∈ M : f(x) = t, x ∈ S}} F dν (Bochner integrals against the restricted measures).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ ν : Measure (Eucl P)) (M S : Set (Eucl P)) (f g F : Eucl P → ℝ), NullMeasurableSet M μ → MeasurableSet S → Measurable f → (∀ Z : Set (Eucl P), Z ⊆ M → μ Z = 0 → ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), ν (Z ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) = 0) → (∀ x, x ∉ S → g x = 0) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μ.restrict M), x ∈ S → g x = F x) → ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), ∫ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂ν = ∫ x in {x | x ∈ M ∧ f x = t ∧ x ∈ S}, F x ∂ν
